Galaksi kataloğu: NED / literatür değerl: Galaxy catalogue: NED / literature values. Black holes: literature values (GRAVITY, EHT, Gaia DR3 etc.); rendering is real-time ray tracing in the Schwarzschild metric. Nebula, cluster and remnant landmarks are shown at their real positions as three-dimensional clouds derived from NASA/ESA Hubble (public domain) and ESO (CC BY 4.0) photographs; those without a photograph are procedural representations. Pulsars: ATNF Pulsar Catalogue values; beam geometry is schematic. Procedural stars, galaxies and the cosmic web are generated deterministically and must not be confused with real catalogues.

Dünyanın her yerinde insanları uzay ve a: An open-source space simulator and astrophysics classroom, built to bring people everywhere closer to space and astrophysics
Your Eyes In Space, dünyanın her yerinde: Your Eyes In Space was built to raise public awareness of space, astrophysics and astronomy and to spark interest in them all over the world. 109,000 real stars, real galaxies, black holes and pulsars; a mission planner, narrated tours and interactive lessons that follow a textbook, all in a single browser tab.
Okullar, gökevleri, bilim merkezleri, bi: We're open to joint projects, translations and contributions with schools, planetariums, science centres, science communicators and researchers. An e-mail is enough.
